BL-1453 — Thirteen more TypeScript sites carry a private ^BL-\d+ ticket pattern (Telegram ambulance and expedite, cursor operator exec, legacy topic reconcile, catch-up feed, telegram control core, bridge ticket update, feature-handler registration text, deprecate-check id parsing, delivery-metrics path classifiers), so a GH-<n> ticket cannot be ambulanced, expedited, reconciled or counted; every site uses BL-1452's shared predicate and none keeps a private one
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-06 by the specifier with BL-1452; depends_on BL-1452 for
the predicate it consumes. The three wiring anchors name the sites with
a live operator-facing consequence (ambulance, expedite, delivery
counts); the rest are gated by scenario 02's derived grep.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Minted by the specifier together with BL-1452 from a sweep of extension/src for BL-only patterns; the sweep's hit list is …
BL-1453 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1453" (or "reject BL-1453 <reason>") to act.
